customManagers.description: Versions pinned in Dockerfile ARGs and compose build args, annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Python is on 3.12 deliberately (requires-python >=3.12). Patch bumps only; a new minor is a decision, not a PR.
The openclaw npm version is pinned in the goplaces-node Dockerfile only (compose has no build arg). Keep it in step with the OPENCLAW_IMAGE tag in pickleclaw.
Woodpecker server and agent must run the same version, so bump them together.
